verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec. The probe found that all candidate OpenAPI and Swagger paths return 404. The MCP server's structured access to the API reference and the llms.txt file are adjacent features, not a downloadable machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
